name: Muhammad Hadi Yusufali
role: Creator at the intersection of tech and creativity
description: Writing my story as you read it. A creator experimenting across many mediums at the intersection of tech and creativity.
bio:
I'm a filmmaker and content creator with over seven years of experience. I'm currently Chief of Staff & Head of Story at sync. — a research lab modifying humans in video.

On the side, I co-founded Awaiten Films, a Bay Area production company with my friend Aalyan, and I co-host Journey Tellers, a podcast on the story of the Muslim West. I've had the privilege of working with some of the best creatives I know on a few hundred projects so far.
